entry.title: Nina Tower
entry.note: Fresh exact Q520839 parcel way 64890124 at 8 Yeung Uk Road identifies the complex; named/addressed 80-floor tall way 112284860 and hotel way 112284790 (hotel Q115967045) identify the individual towers inside it. The inspected north-up Planning Department 2018 A-2 site plan independently signs tall tower northwest and curved hotel southeast, Yeung Uk northeast and Tai Ho northwest. New origin is the tall footprint area centroid, not the old unverified catalog coordinate. Heading follows north edge tall vertices 22 to 19: native +X ENE about 75.56 degrees, -Z NNW about 345.56 degrees. Reviewed geometry uses each raw local ring, including the crescent hotel and main podium, plus a separate low western bus-terminal wing. Original south-west hotel offset and schematic podium are preserved only in the old recipe. Public northwest frontage follows mapped Tai Ho-side wall, supported by planning A-3 point-2 photograph; door count/offset and slender canopy are approximate. Skybridge joins tall southeast edge to short northwest inner curve at working 151.7 m deck; curvature, exact attachments, sail roof radii, roof high sides and pavement datum are photograph/diagram reconstructions, not surveys. Nina Mall 2 across Tai Ho is excluded. OSM 318 m tall/42 m podium differ from registry 320.4 m and original working podium 32.8 m; reviewed podium uses eight rows to mapped 42 m, with explicitly reconstructed height allocation and no ground-datum survey. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
